source: NI 43-101 Technical Report, Hot Breccia Project, B.L. Laird P.Geo., effective 2026-06-30
note: Event wording supplied by the project owner; section numbers looked up in the report text. Not reviewed by the Qualified Person.

events.text: Small workings on shear zones along dyke margins, mined for gold.
1970: Kennecott aeromagnetic survey. 1971: Kennecott IP survey.
Barrett mapping (1:12,000); claims staked by Bear Creek Mining; two IP lines.
Seven holes drilled (OC and OCC series; Conoco joint venture 1979-81). OC-3 year unknown.
Kennecott furnished limited logs only; drill core discarded.
Airborne ZTEM and magnetic survey (Geotech), 312 line-km.
Prismo surface sampling published; ExploreTech modelling.
BLM permit for ten drill sites.
